content.content: deccy is implemented in Rust, built with cargo as a single static binary.
content.rationale: A single static binary fits one CLI for humans and agents alike in any repo: no runtime to install and one artifact to distribute. jj itself is Rust, so ecosystem alignment holds and future jj-library linkage stays open where shelling out starts. serde with a JSON Schema validator covers the draft 2020-12 schema, and assert_cmd with tempfile covers the exact-output EARS clauses. Go offers a weaker schema story and TypeScript drags a runtime and packaging step onto any-machine use; leaving the stack open is rejected because implementation refs and gates could not be concrete.
